# observe_monitors (Data Source)

Monitors the token can see, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "observe_monitors" "shop" {
  tag = "shop"
}

output "shop_monitor_urls" {
  value = [for m in data.observe_monitors.shop.monitors : m.url]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Only this organization's monitors
- `search` (String) Part of the URL or label
- `tag` (String) Only monitors with this tag
- `team_id` (String) Only this team's monitors

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `critical` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)

- `organization_id` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `team_id` (String)
- `url` (String)
